overallSummary: Fabio Giglietto maintains a strong professional academic presence across Bluesky, LinkedIn, and Mastodon, totaling 3,580 followers. Content primarily focuses on computational social science, disinformation research, grant awards, tool releases (CooRnet v2.0), and academic recruitment. Engagement is consistently high across all channels, driven by timely updates on research milestones and career opportunities.

contentThemes.description: Announcements of new papers, conference presentations, and methodology discussions related to coordinated inauthentic behavior and disinformation.
Updates on computational tools developed by the research team, such as CooRnet v2.0.
Posts highlighting major research grants awarded and recruitment posts for postdocs and PhD candidates.

recommendations: Increase posting frequency on Mastodon and LinkedIn to match the strong audience reception seen on Bluesky.
Include direct media or visual links (infographics, publication covers) to further boost engagement on academic publication updates.
Leverage calls-to-action (CTAs) consistently across all platforms to drive traffic to research papers and open team positions.

platformInsights.bluesky: Yields the highest average engagement rate (6.14%), with reposts significantly driving reach on publication and recruitment updates.
platformInsights.mastodon: Provides steady engagement within the academic community (AOIR instance), particularly for technical tool updates like CooRnet.
platformInsights.linkedin: Generates the highest raw volume of likes and direct comments (95 likes on grant news), making it the primary hub for career and funding announcements.

topPerformingContent.content: Just published our new paper on coordinated inauthentic behavior on social media platforms!
